title: Open scalar balancing respects composition of ordinary etale open extensions
statement:
Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings. All schemes and morphisms below are arbitrary [def-pc-scheme]. Write $D_R(T)=D(T_{\mathrm{et}},R)$ for the ordinary unbounded derived category of constant-ring module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], $Q_T=(-)\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and $u_R^*$ for exact inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Use the canonical K-flat scalar/pullback isomorphism $\lambda_u:u_B^*Q_T\cong Q_Wu_A^*$ for $u:W\to T$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. For an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow T$ [def-weil-open-immersion], use exact extension by zero $j_{!,R}$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Let $\beta_j:Q_Tj_{!,A}\cong j_{!,B}Q_U$ be the balancing isomorphism of [lem-coef-etale-open-tensor]. Normalize its inverse by the open adjunction: $\beta_{j,M}^{-1}$ has transpose $\lambda_{j,j_{!,A}M}^{-1}\circ Q_U(\eta_{j,A,M})$, where $\eta_{j,A}$ is the unit [def-pur-open-coefficient-normalizations, lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction, lem-coef-etale-open-tensor]. Let $a:U\hookrightarrow V$ and $b:V\hookrightarrow T$ be open immersions. Write $c_R:b_{!,R}a_{!,R}\cong(ba)_{!,R}$ for the canonical extension composition [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition]. Then, for every $M\in D_A(U)$,
$$\beta_{ba,M}\circ Q_T(c_{A,M})=c_{B,Q_UM}\circ b_{!,B}(\beta_{a,M})\circ\beta_{b,a_{!,A}M}.$$
For the identity open immersion, $\beta_{\mathrm{id}}$ is the identity under the canonical open-extension identifications. These equations hold on the entire derived category.
